author: Bobby Grayson

metadata.prompt:
I want to try something.

I was chatting with Dan Abromov about some math work hes doing, and hes working in Lean. 

Lean is interesting for two reasons:

1. math
2. formal program verification etc

What if we were to integrate some cool lean tooling into deciduous? We could start with like, 

dan said this

one of my favorite parts of the project was making this automatically generated proof map. here is the proof map for the headline result: https://gaearon.github.io/conway-refinement/#/map/conway-refinement

[Image #1]

so what if we started off with

1. integrate a lean proof walkthrough that deciduous represents and can walk through
2. make it so it can present it nicely 
3. start offering some tooling where we think about using lean to evaluate decision trees but not really? 
4. I dont know what can you think of? There is something cool here I guess

title: Integrate Lean proof maps into deciduous
